CVE-2012-1096.title: NetworkManager 0.9 and earlier allows local users to use other us ...
CVE-2012-1096.description: NetworkManager 0.9 and earlier allows local users to use other users' certificates or private keys when making a connection via the file path when adding a new connection.

CVE-2016-4477.title: wpa_supplicant 0.4.0 through 2.5 does not reject \n and \r charac ...
CVE-2016-4477.description: wpa_supplicant 0.4.0 through 2.5 does not reject \n and \r characters in passphrase parameters, which allows local users to trigger arbitrary library loading and consequently gain privileges, or cause a denial of service (daemon outage), via a crafted (1) SET, (2) SET_CRED, or (3) SET_NETWORK command.

CVE-2020-12695.title: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-0 ...
CVE-2020-12695.description: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.

CVE-2022-23304.title: The implementations of EAP-pwd in hostapd before 2.10 and wpa_sup ...
CVE-2022-23304.description: The implementations of EAP-pwd in hostapd before 2.10 and wpa_supplicant before 2.10 are vulnerable to side-channel attacks as a result of cache access patterns. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2019-9495.

CVE-2023-52424.title: The IEEE 802.11 standard sometimes enables an adversary to trick  ...
CVE-2023-52424.description: The IEEE 802.11 standard sometimes enables an adversary to trick a victim into connecting to an unintended or untrusted network with Home WEP, Home WPA3 SAE-loop. Enterprise 802.1X/EAP, Mesh AMPE, or FILS, aka an "SSID Confusion" issue. This occurs because the SSID is not always used to derive the pairwise master key or session keys, and because there is not a protected exchange of an SSID during a 4-way handshake.
